title: Monsoon and Landfall
premise: Storm chaser Dominic Vasquez, drowning in debt to the Delgado brothers' cheerful loan operation, accepts a dying prospector's map in exchange for a promise to deliver it to the man's estranged daughter before the mountain passes close. The map points to a lost silver lode that three parties want: the Delgados, who hold his debt; a rival survey crew; and the daughter herself, who believes her father abandoned her. Crossing the range through monsoon and early snow, Dominic must choose between selling the truth for his freedom and honoring a promise to a dead man. He reaches the daughter as the passes seal behind him, exposes the Delgados' fraud, and finds that the real inheritance was never silver but the found family that carried him over the mountain.
about_author: Edmund Ishikawa is a former geophysical surveyor who spent a decade chasing storms across the American Southwest before turning to fiction. He writes adventure novels about people whose debts are measured in more than money.

chapters.title: The Weight of Good Weather
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Chasing a dying storm across the flats to impress a client, he calculates how little he actually owns: a truck, a compass, and a debt to the Delgado brothers. The beat is restless charm masking dread.

chapters.title: Optimists with Ledgers
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The Delgado brothers collect with smiles and arithmetic, giving him one week. Their youngest, Marisol, quietly warns him they never forgive twice. Beat: humiliation sharpened into urgency.

chapters.title: A Trade at Dusk
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. At a roadside diner he meets Elias Crane, a prospector coughing blood, who trades a hand-drawn map for a sworn promise: carry it to his daughter June in Kestrel Pass before snowfall. Beat: reluctant oath taken.

chapters.title: What the Map Shows
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV, night camp. Studying the map, he realizes it marks the Verruga Lode — a legend worth more than his debt ten times over. He understands what the Delgados would do for it. Beat: temptation arrives.

chapters.title: The First Tail
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. A gray pickup shadows him out of town; inside are two of the Delgados' collectors. A rain-slick chase ends with Dominic losing them in a dry wash. Beat: the hunt begins.

chapters.title: June Crane Hates Her Father
chapters.summary: POV shift to June, a mechanic in a foothill town who has spent twenty years not waiting for Elias. She recognizes the compass in a stranger's hand and slams her garage door. Beat: grief armored as anger.

chapters.title: Monsoon Season
chapters.summary: Alternating POV. Dominic shelters from a flash flood with a wandering botanist, Odile, and her foster son Teo, who attach themselves to his journey uninvited. Beat: the found family assembles by accident.

chapters.title: The Rival Survey
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. He discovers Halloran's survey crew — hired by someone with deep pockets — already mapping the same ridge. A tense parley over coffee reveals they know his name and his debt. Beat: enemies multiply.

chapters.title: Marisol's Bargain
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV. Sent to retrieve Dominic, she instead offers him a private deal: bring her the lode's location and she'll burn his ledger page. He refuses; she doesn't report him. Beat: loyalty tested from an unexpected quarter.

chapters.title: The Pass Road Washes Out
chapters.summary: Teo's POV. A mudslide takes the low road with days lost rerouting through high country. Teo, terrified of storms since losing his parents, confesses why he follows Dominic. Beat: vulnerability builds trust.

chapters.title: Elias's Letters
chapters.summary: Odile's POV. Reading letters sewn into the map's backing, she learns Elias didn't abandon June — he left to pay her mother's hospital debts and was too ashamed to return empty-handed. Beat: truth complicates grief.

chapters.title: Halloran's Offer
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Halloran corners him above treeline: sell the map, walk away rich, debt erased. Dominic stalls, buying time, and realizes Halloran works for the elder Delgado brother himself. Beat: betrayal within betrayal.

chapters.title: First Snow on the Ridge
chapters.summary: June's POV. June, having tracked Dominic to reclaim her father's effects, catches up as early snow dusts the pass. She and Dominic argue about Elias until exhaustion wins. Beat: anger cracking into shared mourning.

chapters.title: The Cache
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Following the map's final cipher, they find Elias's cache: ore samples proving the lode is real — and a letter addressed to June that no one dares open yet. Beat: inheritance made literal.

chapters.title: Ambush at Treeline
chapters.summary: Teo's POV. Halloran's crew strikes at dawn; Odile is hurt covering Teo's escape, and the map is torn in half in the struggle. Beat: cost of the journey becomes blood.

chapters.title: Marisol Breaks Rank
chapters.summary: Marisol's POV. Ordered to finish the job, Marisol instead returns the stolen half-map, revealing her brother intends to silence everyone who's seen it. Beat: defector joins the family.

chapters.title: Whiteout
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. The storm of the decade hits as they climb the final saddle. Lost, half-frozen, Dominic navigates by compass and memory of Elias's descriptions. Beat: the promise outweighs survival math.

chapters.title: Kestrel Pass, Closed Behind Them
chapters.summary: June's POV. They reach the valley as the pass seals with snow — safe, trapped, and followed. Halloran's crew descends toward them anyway. Beat: no way back, only forward.

chapters.title: The Reading
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. In a miner's cabin, June finally opens her father's letter: an apology, the deed to a small honest claim, and his wish that she judge him by the promise he kept, not the one he broke. Beat: forgiveness begins.

chapters.title: Landfall
chapters.summary: All POVs converge. Halloran's assault on the cabin fails when Marisol testifies to the Delgados' fraud and the storm itself scatters the hired men. Beat: climax — loyalty and truth finally aligned.

chapters.title: Ledgers Burned
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV. Spring melt brings investigators; the Delgados fall, and Dominic's debt dies with their operation. He declines the lode claim, ceding it to June and the surveyors' honest hands. Beat: freedom chosen over fortune.

chapters.title: Monsoon Again
chapters.summary: Dominic's POV, one year later. He chases storms again, but now the truck holds four: Odile navigating, Teo spotting, June laughing at his driving, postcards from Marisol arriving like weather. Beat: resolution — the inheritance kept.
